Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.gbpuat.ac.in. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GBPUAT Senior Research Fellow (SRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the GBPUAT Senior Research Fellow (SRF) recruitment is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is M.Sc. Agri. Entomology with a 4-year Bachelor Degree and at least two years of experience in bio efficacy testing.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the GBPUAT Senior Research Fellow (SRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be sent offline by post to the Principal Investigator at their departmental address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology located?
faq.answer: G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology is located in Pantnagar, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 263145.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) role will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is scheduled for 01st October 2026.
